issue: Regenerative work recovery needs an acquired joint branch-return ledger; endpoint clocks/rewards cannot supply it.
clarification: N814 preserves N777 common-committor and clock-selection distinctions and N783 joint retained-reward/cost requirements. Uniform pointwise loss/reaction ratios support an adaptive bound; pooled rates fail. CO product is terminal and no mobile retained-repair carrier kernel is supplied, so N783 theorem is not transferred. Survivor-only floor is scope-specific; partial-loss/product work returns are new unacquired operations. No historical claim invalidated.
